findings.title: Reduced-motion visitors lose content
findings.evidence: 1 elements stay invisible when prefers-reduced-motion is set: ul.u-list > li.now > span.tick > svg.i "svg".
findings.fix: The reduced-motion branch skips the code that reveals content. Make elements visible by default under reduced motion instead of skipping the reveal.

findings.title: Interactive elements give no hover feedback
findings.evidence: 5/12 distinct controls did not change on hover: Skip to content, Drift, 01 Wind down Tell Drift when you, Auto-drift, Monthly.
findings.fix: Every link/button needs a state change: buttons lift 1–2px or shift background with a 160–240ms ease-out transition and a pressed scale(.97); text links animate an underline (scaleX 0→1 from the left); cards raise shadow and scale media 1.03.

findings.title: Text is drawn at a fraction of its size
findings.evidence: 8 element(s) whose glyphs are less than half their font size: mobile scrollY 5568px: “Awake” drawn at 36% of its line height; mobile scrollY 5568px: “REM” drawn at 36% of its line height; mobile scrollY 5568px: “Light” drawn at 36% of its line height.
findings.fix: A scale transform never finished, usually a count-up or reveal that scales from 0. Reveal with opacity and a short translate instead, or make sure the final state is scale(1) even when the trigger never fires.

findings.title: Layout properties are animated
findings.evidence: 123 animations/transitions on height, width, paddingBottom, padding-bottom, paddingTop; 194 inline-style layout writes.
findings.fix: Animate transform and opacity (and clip-path for reveals) instead of width/height/top/left/margin; they run on the compositor and avoid reflow jank. For accordions use grid-template-rows 0fr→1fr or measure once and animate a scale/clip.

findings.title: Hover feedback is sluggish
findings.evidence: 3 hover transitions last over 600 ms (e.g. header#nav > div.nav-right > a.btn.btn-sm::before: 900 ms).
findings.fix: Hover/press feedback should start immediately and settle in 150–300ms; longer feels laggy under the pointer.

findings.title: Many elements loop forever
findings.fix: Limit ambient loops to one or two focal elements (a hero visual, a marquee). Constant motion everywhere competes with content and drains battery; pause off-screen loops.

findings.title: Tap targets are small on mobile
findings.evidence: button#autoBtn 122×26, footer.footer > div.container.foot-grid > div.foot-brand > a.brand 79×28, footer.footer > div.container.foot-grid > nav.foot-col > a 90×24, footer.footer > div.container.foot-grid > nav.foot-col > a 94×24
findings.fix: Give touch controls at least 44×44px of hit area (padding or a pseudo-element hit box).

findings.title: Body text is small on mobile
The page looks like the default AI-built template
findings.evidence: It shares 8 of 9 traits of the landing page coding agents build by default: display face Instrument Serif, text face Geist, italic accent word in the headline, near-black ground, small uppercase eyebrow above the headline, pill buttons, grain overlay, marquee.
findings.fix: Unless the brief asks for these, change at least four: a display face chosen for this subject, a ground and accent taken from its world, a hero built around one dominant element instead of headline-left/object-right, square or cut button shapes, and sections laid out from their content rather than eyebrow, marquee and bento. A page can earn every trait; it should not get them by default.

findings.title: A few text elements have low contrast
findings.fix: Raise contrast of these elements to at least 4.5:1.
